recipes.comment: [Planetary Industry] Crush either mined Desh ore or freighted raw Desh from every installed source into one coarse grit before chemical enrichment.
[Planetary Industry] Enrich Desh grit into a clean mineral concentrate before wet chemical treatment.
[Planetary Industry] Leach two Desh concentrates with canonical TFMG sulfuric acid and water in a steel mixing vat.
[Planetary Industry] Reduce the leached Desh compound between two electrodes in a heated steel vat to recover one canonical ingot.

[Planetary Industry] Build a Desh-framed descent console around the inherited orbital computer and navigation table, with one monitor, etched backplane, engineering logic, TFMG board pair, and local ComputerCraft authority
[Planetary Industry] Crush either mined Ostrum ore or freighted raw Ostrum into one coarse grit after the lunar metal line is commissioned.
[Planetary Industry] Enrich Ostrum grit into a clean mineral concentrate before aggressive leaching.
[Planetary Industry] Leach two Ostrum concentrates with a larger TFMG sulfuric-acid charge in a firebrick-lined mixing vat.
[Planetary Industry] Reduce the leached Ostrum compound between two electrodes in a heated firebrick-lined vat.

[Planetary Industry] Wire every commissioned outpost service into an open Ostrum mission console around the Mars computer and shared navigation table, with one etched backplane, engineering governor, and local host computer
[Planetary Industry] Crush mined Venus Calorite ore or freighted raw Calorite into one coarse grit without multiplying the offworld feedstock.
[Planetary Industry] Enrich Calorite grit into a controlled high-temperature concentrate before aggressive wet chemistry.
[Planetary Industry] Leach four Calorite concentrates with a full sulfuric-acid charge and additional wash water in a seven-block firebrick vat.
[Planetary Industry] Reduce the leached Calorite compound between two electrodes in a superheated seven-block firebrick vat.
[Planetary Industry] Assemble a telemetry workstation beneath the Sputnik crown, with the navigation table centered between etched backplanes and prior guidance.

[Outer System Industry] Build the station-services rack as a titanium-framed heavy cabinet linking oxygen distribution, ultimate control and energy, local computer authority, Mercury navigation, and gravity normalization

[Interstellar Escape] Build the interstellar authority as an open redundant avionics rack: Moon Crystal and quantum references, engineering logic, Mercury navigation, live station services, ultimate control, antimatter reference, and an independent host computer
[Planetary Industry] Crush mined Venus Calorite ore or freighted raw Calorite into one coarse grit without multiplying the offworld feedstock.
